text: I can explain declarative vs imperative infrastructure and why Terraform reconciles only on apply while Kubernetes controllers reconcile continuously.
I can read a Terraform plan and spot a destroy-and-replace (-/+) on a stateful resource before it is applied.
I can refactor a resource address safely with a moved block and protect databases with prevent_destroy and deletion protection.
I can set up remote, versioned, encrypted and locked state, and split it per environment and layer to limit blast radius.
I can detect drift on a schedule with plan -detailed-exitcode and decide whether to codify or revert a manual change.
